world-feed-db vendored frontend assets - served locally; the viewer has NO runtime CDN dependency.
- Leaflet 1.9.4 (BSD-2-Clause) + Leaflet.markercluster 1.5.3 (MIT) - map + clustering
- hls.js 1.5.17 (Apache-2.0) - HLS playback where the browser lacks native support
Sources: unpkg.com (leaflet, leaflet.markercluster), cdn.jsdelivr.net (hls.js). Fetched 2026-10-06.
Map tiles (when enabled): https://tile.openstreetmap.org - (c) OpenStreetMap contributors.
